content.snl: variable(__list__(Type.annotation(@$\mathbb{K}$,Type),Type.annotation(@V,Type),LA.Field($\mathbb{K}$),LA.VectorSpace(V,$\mathbb{K}$)),def(Module.finrank($\mathbb{K}$,V),,$\dim_{\mathbb{K}} V = \operatorname{card} b \quad (\text{any basis } b;\ 0 \text{ if infinite-rank})$))

values.zh-CN: $\dim_{\mathbb{K}} V$ 是 $V$ 的有限维数，等于任意一组基的基数；无限秩时约定为 $0$。Lean 中 `Module.finrank 𝕂 V` 接受两个显式参数：标量域与模。
values.en: $\dim_{\mathbb{K}} V$ is the finite dimension of $V$, the cardinality of any basis; it is $0$ by convention for infinite rank. In Lean `Module.finrank 𝕂 V` takes two explicit arguments, the scalar field and the module.
